div.div: 1. Removed all hardcoded JWT secrets — tokenGenerator.js now throws on missing env vars
2. Removed hardcoded cookie secret — app.js crashes on startup if COOKIE_SECRET is missing
3. Added SUPERADMIN_SECRET_KEY validation — auth.service.js hashes and verifies the key
4. Added rate limiting to upload endpoints — prevents Cloudinary cost attacks
5. Fixed CORS origin validation — rejects unknown origins instead of defaulting to localhost
Critical Security Fixes
6. Fixed broken import path — auth.middleware.js now imports from permission.js (singular)
7. Created proper auth.service.js — was previously mislabeled farmer request controller logic
8. Removed duplicate models/user.model.js — single source of truth in src/model/user.model.js
9. Standardized user schema — added isActive, createdBy with sparse index, User role
10. Removed dead code — deleted auth.User.js, consolidated duplicate farmer request controllers
Dataflow & Architecture Fixes
11. Removed runValidators: false from upload controller — schema validation now enforced
12. Added upload rate limiting — 10 uploads per 15 minutes per IP
13. Cloudinary service optimized — removed redundant config() calls
File Upload API Fixes
14. Fixed stock check race condition — single atomic findOneAndUpdate instead of read-then-write
15. Fixed order status update race condition — findOneAndUpdate with { status: 'pending' } guard
16. Eliminated double query in getOrderByIdController — single query with populate + auth check
Order & Transaction Fixes
17. Added MongoDB connection pooling — maxPoolSize: 20, timeouts configured
18. Added response compression — compression middleware for JSON payloads
19. Added graceful shutdown — SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers in server.js
Performance Fixes
20. Enhanced error middleware — request IDs, structured JSON logging, SyntaxError handling
21. Enhanced asyncHandler — logs all async errors with method + path before passing to handler
22. Added request timestamp to /health endpoint
Error Handling & Logging
23. Removed bcrypt hashing of refresh tokens — JWTs are already signed, unnecessary overhead
24. Fixed sameSite cookie — dynamic based on NODE_ENV
25. Added User auth routes — /auth/User/register, /auth/User/login
26. Added toSafeObject() method to User model
Auth Fixes
New Required Environment Variables
A+ Grade Fixes — Agro POS Server
